niche.habitat: Evaporite flats and shallow salt crusts

body: Hexapod with a faceted, crystalline carapace and low-profile stance

links: High UV flux drives selection for UV camouflage in open pans
F-star SED delivers high-energy photons with transparent window

skill.effect: The creature's mirrored carapace reflects ultraviolet light, allowing you to step into its glow and become nearly invisible to those who track it.

chains.weakness: Reflection mechanism creates polarization artifact; visible to polarization hunters.
observe: Carapace glints blue-white under direct starlight
Moves across salt crust without breaking surface tension
Shadow on polarization sensor shows stark vector mismatch

journal.en: A walking salt-crystal that hides its face in the sun's glare.

plausibility.summary: Hypersaline evaporite flats are strong UV/visible reflectors; selection under F14 high UV favors matching substrate spectral albedo. A mineralized or wax-layered cuticle with oriented microfacets can approach halite-like reflectance without requiring impossible optics. Perfect 90% UV invisibility to all sensors is a gameplay exaggeration, not a hard biological limit.
fixes: Hypersaline evaporite flats are strong UV/visible reflectors; selection under F14 high UV favors matching substrate spectral albedo. A mineralized or wax-layered cuticle with oriented microfacets can approach halite-like reflectance without requiring impossible optics. Perfect 90% UV invisibility to all sensors is a gameplay exaggeration, not a hard biological limit.

analogues.organism: Metallic/structural reflectors in Chrysina jewel scarabs; UV-reflective wax blooms on desert tenebrionid beetles; counter-illumination and substrate-matching in flatfish and sand fleas (spectral, not UV-perfect).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Hypersaline pans produce strong sky polarization
Low aerosol scattering preserves polarization patterns
Thin atmosphere and clear zenith create predictable polarization vectors

skill.effect: You can scatter a shimmering polarized foil that perfectly mimics the creature's artifact, and it will draw the creature strongly toward the spot for a short while.

chains.weakness: Polarization hunters can track Salaris even when UV-camouflaged.
observe: Movement leaves polarization trail on ground-scanner
Carapace facets align with zenith polarization angle
Salaris freezes when sky polarization shifts (cloud/flare)

journal.en: It wears the sky's polarization like a suit, but the suit has a zipper.

plausibility.summary: F11 gives strong, predictable sky polarization on clear zenith; specular reflection from horizontal crystals follows Fresnel rules, so a faceted carapace aligned to the pan can match average radiance but still differ in polarization fraction from rough salt or skylight. Predators with polarization channel gain a convergent hunting axis when UV albedo camouflage works—classic multi-channel camouflage breakdown.
fixes: F11 gives strong, predictable sky polarization on clear zenith; specular reflection from horizontal crystals follows Fresnel rules, so a faceted carapace aligned to the pan can match average radiance but still differ in polarization fraction from rough salt or skylight. Predators with polarization channel gain a convergent hunting axis when UV albedo camouflage works—classic multi-channel camouflage breakdown.

analogues.organism: Mantis shrimp and cephalopod polarization vision; cuttlefish and octopus polarization camouflage that fails against polarization-sensitive hunters; butterflies with polarized wing reflections.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: High UV-B/C flux causes rapid DNA damage
F-star SED plus low ozone column

skill.effect: The creature's rapid photolyase cycling naturally absorbs harsh ultraviolet rays, so standing nearby significantly lessens the stinging heat that would otherwise build up on your skin.

chains.weakness: Metabolic drain; Salaris must feed constantly, reducing stealth time.
observe: Salaris pauses to expose ventral photolyase glands to starlight
Body temperature spikes briefly during repair

journal.en: It drinks the light to stitch its genome back together.

plausibility.summary: F14 (3.5× Earth UV-B/C) plus F9 transparent window make constitutive DNA damage likely for diurnal open-pan life. Light-driven photolyase repair is a real UV countermeasure; diurnal exposure imposes a measurable ATP cost and favors constant feeding, consistent with F17.
fixes: F14 (3.5× Earth UV-B/C) plus F9 transparent window make constitutive DNA damage likely for diurnal open-pan life. Light-driven photolyase repair is a real UV countermeasure; diurnal exposure imposes a measurable ATP cost and favors constant feeding, consistent with F17.

analogues.organism: Photolyase in plants, fungi, many invertebrates and microbes; UV-tolerant halophiles in high-irradiance shallow brines.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: High-frequency sound attenuates rapidly in thin air
Acoustic signaling is ineffective for coordination
Low gas density suppresses HF coupling

skill.effect: The creature moves with a silent, gliding crawl that leaves no audible trace, allowing you to slip past vibration-sensitive hunters without alerting them.

chains.weakness: Silent movement requires precise balance; slips on wet salt.
observe: No sound despite rapid leg movement
Dust does not ripple under feet
Predators hunt by sight/polarization, not sound

journal.en: A shadow that refuses to make the air shake.

plausibility.summary: State explicitly: quiet in air (Ghost Step), not vibration-deaf on the crust—soft pulvilli or salt-surface tension skating reduces impact pulses; wet salt slip weakness stays.
fixes: State explicitly: quiet in air (Ghost Step), not vibration-deaf on the crust—soft pulvilli or salt-surface tension skating reduces impact pulses; wet salt slip weakness stays.

analogues.organism: Tiger beetles and hunting wasps with quiet adhesive tarsi; substrate-borne vibration hunting in spiders and scorpions despite quiet air steps.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

relations.note: (council kind 'Prey of') Salaris is the primary prey of Crisol; its UV camouflage forces Crisol to rely on polarization hunting.
(council kind 'Hunter of') Crisol exploits Salaris's polarization artifact; a player using a polarizing filter can bypass the Crisol's gaze.

secrets: Salaris carapace can be coated in oil to scramble polarization vectors, hiding from Crisol.
Photolyase cycling is triggered by blue light; a blue flare can stun a Salaris in repair mode.
moments: When the M-dwarf flare strikes, the salt pan flashes blindingly in UV; the Salaris dissolves into the brilliance, but its polarization shadow remains etched in the sand like a wound.

journal.en: Salaris mirrors the salt's soul in the ultraviolet.
The salt pan is a mirror, but the mirror lies.
